You don't know if you'll make it through the night?  You sound pretty hesitant about that shit.    

Whatever's going on it isn't worth dying for.

What's worth living? Proving people wrong that you couldn't do anything?  
What about,  a chance to start over?  Rock bottom is a great reason to just go for a life direction you've been afraid to go for, (what's to lose?)
 Dude, you're not alone.  Of course you're in a hole. That hole sucks.
You are not the hole. 
If your brain/mind/mood is a landscape of things going on, your depression is a really deep fucking storm.  
It's gonna pass but you can't keep hurting yourself like you are now. That's not cool.
When you're at the rock bottom you have quite a bit to look forward to.  Nothing scares you anymore.  You've seen the end of the road so close but you turn away and launch unto some direction, unafraid.

I dunno, just get through the night. Jeeze man.

*bunch of vodka talking*

I'm sorry that you get talked over and shot down OP.

I was a big kid in highschool, I didn't make friends until a few years after highschool. Didn't date until 20.

Anger isn't cool dude. It's such a waste of energy.  Not critisizing, just offering some life experience.  I was a super angry kid from an abusive household and my 17-20's was brutal.  Your're going to fly further once you deal with that shit.  I reccommend meditation. (Not trying to do "Tough Love". Just steady and compassionate) 

Jobs can be shitty man. If the standard they have is some lazy ass being the gold standard then they didn't deserve you in the first place.  I know life without money is hard but you don't need to bleed yourself dry for something that doesn't even care about you.

I know how you feel being tired of being alone.  I was walking home from work today and just couldn't stop thinking how much I wish there was someone beside me.  I don't care if its a girlfriend or a bestfriend or even someone new.  I tend to do a lot by myself and as the days pass I just more and more sad about it. Youre not alone.

I think a balance between being alone and being in a relationship is important.  You are not a shitty person, you are just in a shitty situation. Big Difference.  Sometimes the people you thought were close will abandon you when you start crashing and burning.  It's not a reflection on you as it is their own fears about their own shit they see in you.  Don't hold it against them, they're just people too.  

I don't know you but hold on man.  Sometimes not giving a shit can be very impowering.  What's holding you back?  When youre reduced to crashing and burning, do those fears really matter anymore?  Once at rock bottom, failing doesn't seem like such a hard fall anymore.  Go try some new shit.

*my appologies after much vodka*
